settings.description: One source library, one output library, one build profile.
settings.pathsHint: Use container paths. The output directory must be empty when first enabled.

settings.outputHint: Read-write mount; give Navidrome read-only access to this directory.
settings.enabled: Enable library scanning and background jobs
settings.mountHint: Keep container root paths stable after indexing. After a mount change, verify the directories and save Settings to acknowledge it.
settings.encodingHint: Profile changes mark artifacts for rebuilding; existing files stay playable.
settings.modeHint: VBR varies bitrate with audio complexity; CBR uses a fixed bitrate.
settings.qualityHint: V2 is recommended, typically around 190 kbps; V0 is highest quality, V9 lowest.
settings.concurrencyHint: Default: 1. Higher concurrency increases CPU and disk load.
settings.encodingNote: Preserve tags and ReplayGain · One cover.jpg per album · Validate before replacement
settings.integrationsHint: Build from upgrade events; refresh the playback library after each batch.
settings.lidarrPrefixHint: The FLAC root seen by Lidarr. Leave blank if it matches MusicForge's path.
settings.secretConfigured: Configured. Leave blank to keep the existing secret.
settings.webhookHint: At least 24 characters; used only to trigger scans.
settings.webhookCredentials: Lidarr Webhook: Username = musicforge, Password = independent secret
settings.navHint: Navidrome 0.59.0+ scans targeted album directories; older versions use a regular scan.
settings.oidcHint: Only the bound administrator identity can log in. Keep the local password for recovery.
settings.originsHint: Set at startup. Each URL has its own login cookie; OIDC finishes on the primary URL.
settings.primaryBindHint: To bind OIDC, sign in at the primary URL with the local administrator account.
